options.title: What if all {fact1} UN countries became one?
options.first_line: What if tomorrow every border on Earth disappeared, and all the United Nations' countries became one?
options.first_frame: The colourful political world map, an eraser already sweeping across Europe and rubbing the borders out as the colours melt together.

options.title: One passport for every UN country?
options.first_line: What if one passport let you into every place on Earth, because there was only one country left?
options.first_frame: A passport landing on the world map, every country's flag folding down around it.

options.title: Erase every UN border tonight. Then what?
options.first_line: Erase every border on the world map tonight. What happens to the world tomorrow?
options.first_frame: A giant pencil eraser rubbing out the line between two countries on the world map, crumbs flying.

why: All three ask the same what-if, but B hangs it on a thing the viewer holds in their own hand (a passport) and its first frame, a passport landing as every flag folds down, tells the story with the sound off.
